headline: Retained Wolf Popper for Dick's Sporting Goods class action and accepted a 7.00% funding schedule with .9 amortization.
summary: Seven new members were accepted, and retirement applications, withdrawals, and transfers were accepted. Cambridge Trust presented third-quarter portfolio results, and pooled fund investments not in compliance with PERAC were discussed. A presentation with Baystate Solutions on office software was scheduled.
decisions: Requested a call with PERAC, Cambridge Trust, and the attorney to discuss options for pooled fund investments not in compliance with PERAC.
Approved September meeting minutes, October expense warrant, September payroll warrants, and September cash reconciliation, 5-0.
Accepted the Option C Pop-Up benefit for a deceased survivor member, 5-0.
Accepted retirement applications, adjustments, and survivor benefits, 5-0.
Accepted the nominations of John Hall and Warren Atkinson Jr. for the two elected seats, 5-0.
Retained Wolf Popper for the Dick's Sporting Goods class action litigation, 5-0.
Accepted 7.00% with a .9 amortization option for the funding schedule, 5-0.
Tabled review of Michael Sacco's opinion letter on substitute longevity until the November meeting.
Approved scheduling a presentation with Baystate Solutions, 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: The Board requested a call with PERAC, Cambridge Trust, and our attorney, two Board members TBD, and the Retirement Director to discuss options.
